* [[Tsurugi Shrine (Tsuruga Te)]] - Located in Tsuruga, Te, Fukui Prefecture.
* [[Tsurugi Shrine (Kyoto)]] - Located in [[Higashiyama-ku, Kyoto|Higashiyama Ward, Kyoto]], [[Kyoto Prefecture]].
* [[Tsurugi Shrine]] - Located in [[Miyoshi, Tokushima]], [[Tokushima Prefecture]].
* [[Hozoseki Shrine]] - Located in [[Mima, Tokushima]], Tokushima Prefecture.
* [[Tsurugi Shrine (Matsue)]] - Located in [[Matsue|Matsue, Shimane]], [[Shimane Prefecture]].
* [[Tsurugi Shrine (Hōfu)]] - Located in [[Hōfu|Hōfu, Yamaguchi]], [[Yamaguchi Prefecture]].
* Tsurugi Shrine - Located in [[Kurate, Fukuoka]], [[Kurate District, Fukuoka]], Fukuoka Prefecture (Kizuki 1349).

* [[Tsurugi Shrine (Nogata)]] - Located in [[Nōgata, Fukuoka|Nogata, Fukuoka]], Fukuoka Prefecture.
* Tsurugi Shrine - Located in [[Miyawaka|Miyawaka, Fukuoka]], Ryūtoku 1639, Fukuoka Prefecture.
